title: Washington D.C. Temple
geometryBasis: Used the native 76 by 42 metre footprint, individual mapped tower outlines and the documented total height of 288 feet including the finial. The original bare-earth USGS field fixes the terrain at entry level.
sectionBasis: The verified 2025 Qualla color panorama shows the long fluted white-marble body, elevated box-like crown stages, needle-like gold spires, open ground-level entrance canopy and repeated upright white entrance fins. IFCAR's cleared Beltway views constrain the east/west tower group silhouettes.
limitations: The six mapped tower bases and heights retain the standing skyline, with individual intermediate tier heights estimated from the photographs. A small abstract upper finial matches the visual scale of the highest ornament.
The exterior omits the detached annex, formal gardens, fountain and interior. Fine iconography and bronze-door graphics are simplified.
